dict.string: daa listens when you hold the push-to-talk key, or continuously if you turn always-on on. Speech is transcribed on this Mac and is not written down until daa decides it was addressed to it.
daa transcribes what you say on this Mac, using Apple's on-device speech models. Nothing is sent to Apple.
daa runs AppleScript to control other apps on your behalf. Every script is shown to you in full and has to be approved by hand before it runs.
